name: Revenger Zero ~OL Inkayouwaku Hen~
original_name: リベンジャーゼロ～OL淫花妖惑篇～
source:
Main character is a scion in a huge company. However, due to conspiracy he loses father and company. He succeeds in infiltrating the company under different name to take his revenge. The easiest way is to establish domination over women working there.
